en.title: The Computer Museum of America Reclamation Project
en.hook: A collaborative effort to reclaim, restore, and archive historical computing artifacts and software.
key_takeaways: Restoration and digital archiving of rare computer hardware and documentation
Community-driven preservation strategies for historical computing technology
Insights into retrocomputing maintenance and legacy system restoration
